verdict.rationale: Workable's API (and MCP server) exposes jobs, candidates, offers, stages, ratings, departments, etc. as JSON, and Workable explicitly states the API gives 'full control over your data,' which supports a DIY export path in an open format. However, there is no documented one-click 'export all my data' or bulk-export/data-portability feature, no mention of standard formats like CSV, and no GDPR-style data takeout tool — it relies entirely on a developer scripting many endpoint calls. Missing for 10: a dedicated bulk data-export/portability feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON archive) export tool, and any documentation of an off-boarding/data takeout process.
